registered_before: any E output with the amended contact rule

why.gate: the registered gate failed on walking contact only: balanced accuracy 0.77 (< 0.85), sensitivity 0.98, specificity 0.58; predicted touchdown 110 ms before the measured heel strike (late swing within 3 cm of the floor), toe-off timing median 0 ms; V1 passed in walk and run, V3 passed in run and jump
why.threshold: the registered tau_frame (0.98 BW) is dominated by unmodeled supports (hands on the floor in dog, a box in drop jumps, a platform in step, the seat in sts) and by source-kinematics failures (3 warrior trials with IK marker RMS 4-5 cm and residuals up to 18 BW); residual in running sits in flight frames (median 0.19 BW) and grows with the filter cutoff (10 and 12 Hz: 0.21 and 0.24 BW), so it is not filter smoothing
why.decided_by: user, after the registered results above

estimator_fix.contact: a sole landmark (heel: calcn origin, toe: toes origin) is in contact when its height is <= its 5th percentile + 3 cm (registered) and its vertical speed on the 100 Hz filtered coordinates is <= 0.2 m/s (约定，未经推演; fixed before evaluation, not tuned on these trials)
estimator_fix.everything_else: unchanged (scaling, IK, 6 Hz filter, NNLS GRF, friction 0.8)
estimator_fix.implementation: biomech.dynamics(..., contact_vmax=0.2); the default None keeps the registered rule for every existing protocol
estimator_fix.evaluation: kin30 variant of the 160 registered trials (IK reused, dynamics recomputed) and all remaining eligible walk trials as a held-out set (kin30, full pipeline)

gate.pass_if: the registered checks on the 160 trials with the fixed estimator, and median V3 balanced accuracy >= 0.85 on the held-out walk trials
gate.fail: X4 runs generation only; the E criterion is not used for X4 until a further registered fix passes on new held-out trials

exclusions.source_quality: IK marker RMS (mean over frames) > 3 cm (约定，未经推演)

threshold.states: per frame, predicted contact (any sole landmark of either foot in contact) or predicted flight (none), from the fixed estimator
threshold.tau_contact: 99th percentile of per-frame residual (BW) over contact frames of the remaining trials, classes weighted equally
threshold.tau_flight: 99th percentile over flight frames, classes with flight frames weighted equally
threshold.tau_run: 95th percentile of per-trial residual RMS over the remaining trials (registered definition)
threshold.use: a frame is infeasible when its residual exceeds the tau of its predicted state; post hoc sensitivity on X3/E4/E1/ARDY-fair, registered for X4 if the gate passes

reported: registered and amended V1-V4 side by side
per-class tau and the share of human frames above each tau
share of excluded trials and frames per class
